description: Models, HDRIs, PBR textures, characters and game-ready asset packs.
description_zh: 模型、HDRI、PBR 材质、角色与游戏即用素材包。

entries.name: Poly Haven
entries.description: 100% CC0 HDRIs, PBR textures and 3D models. The gold standard.
entries.description_zh: 100% CC0 的 HDRI、PBR 材质与 3D 模型，业界标杆。

entries.name: ambientCG
entries.description: 2,000+ CC0 PBR materials for any engine or renderer.
entries.description_zh: 2,000+ CC0 PBR 材质，任何引擎与渲染器可用。

entries.name: FreePBR
entries.description: Free PBR textures and 3D models.
entries.description_zh: 免费 PBR 材质与 3D 模型。
entries.notes: Redistribution of the raw files is not allowed.
entries.notes_zh: 不得二次分发原始文件。

entries.name: Textures.com
entries.description: Enormous material library with a free daily-credit tier.
entries.description_zh: 材质库，免费账户每日有下载额度。
entries.notes: Free credits cap resolution; some commercial uses need a paid license.
entries.notes_zh: 免费额度限制分辨率；部分商业用途需付费许可。

entries.name: Quixel Megascans
entries.description: Photorealistic scanned assets; free for Unreal Engine projects.
entries.description_zh: 照片级扫描资产；用于 Unreal Engine 项目免费。
entries.notes: Free usage is tied to Unreal Engine under current terms; verify before other engines.
entries.notes_zh: 按现行条款免费使用与 UE 绑定；其他引擎请先确认。

entries.name: Mixamo
entries.description: Auto-rigged characters and ready-made animations from Adobe.
entries.description_zh: Adobe 的自动绑定角色与现成动画库。

entries.name: Kenney
entries.description: Thousands of CC0 2D/3D game assets, UI packs and audio.
entries.description_zh: 数千个 CC0 的 2D/3D 游戏素材、UI 包与音频。

entries.name: OpenGameArt
entries.description: Long-running community archive of openly licensed game art.
entries.description_zh: 老牌社区开放许可游戏美术档案库。

entries.name: itch.io Free Game Assets
entries.description: Free section of the itch.io asset marketplace.
entries.description_zh: itch.io 素材市场的免费专区。
entries.notes: No account needed: click Download Now, then "No thanks, just take me to the downloads" to skip the name-your-price step.
entries.notes_zh: 无需注册：点 Download Now 后选「No thanks, just take me to the downloads」，即可跳过随意付费步骤直接下载。

entries.name: Poly Pizza
entries.description: Thousands of free low-poly models, mostly CC0.
entries.description_zh: 数千个免费低多边形模型，多为 CC0。

entries.name: KayKit
entries.description: Themed CC0 asset packs (dungeon, city, nature) for games.
entries.description_zh: 游戏用主题 CC0 素材包（地牢、城市、自然）。

entries.name: Sketchfab Free Models
entries.description: Downloadable free models filterable by CC license.
entries.description_zh: 可按 CC 许可筛选的免费可下载模型。

entries.name: NASA 3D Resources
entries.description: Public domain 3D models, textures and images from NASA.
entries.description_zh: NASA 的公有领域 3D 模型、材质与图像。

entries.name: CGTrader Free Models
entries.description: Free-model section of a major 3D marketplace.
entries.description_zh: 大型 3D 市场的免费模型专区。
entries.notes: Clicking Free Download opens a login panel — an account is needed even for the free models.
entries.notes_zh: 点击 Free Download 会弹出登录面板——即便是免费模型也需要注册账号。

entries.name: TurboSquid Free Models
entries.description: Free-model section of TurboSquid.
entries.description_zh: TurboSquid 的免费模型专区。

entries.name: SketchUp 3D Warehouse
entries.description: Millions of free 3D models from the SketchUp community.
entries.description_zh: SketchUp 社区的数百万免费 3D 模型。

entries.name: Free3D
entries.description: Free-model section of a large 3D marketplace.
entries.description_zh: 大型 3D 市场的免费模型专区。

entries.name: Quaternius
entries.description: Stylish CC0 low-poly packs: animals, dungeons, sci-fi and more.
entries.description_zh: 风格化 CC0 低多边形素材包：动物、地牢、科幻等。

entries.name: CraftPix Freebies
entries.description: Free 2D game assets: sprites, tilesets, GUI kits and more.
entries.description_zh: 免费 2D 游戏素材：精灵图、tileset、GUI 套件等。
entries.notes: Free for commercial game projects; no reselling raw assets.
entries.notes_zh: 可免费用于商业游戏项目；不得转售原始素材。

entries.name: 3D Textures.me
entries.description: Seamless PBR material scans for Blender, Unity, Unreal and Godot, all released as CC0.
entries.description_zh: 适用于 Blender、Unity、Unreal 与 Godot 的无缝 PBR 材质扫描，全部以 CC0 发布。
entries.notes: Textures are downloaded one at a time from each post; a bulk folder is offered to supporters.
entries.notes_zh: 纹理需在各自页面逐个下载；打包全部纹理的文件夹向赞助者提供。

entries.name: Open HDRI
entries.description: Real-world captured HDRIs released as CC0, in unclipped linear high-resolution form.
entries.description_zh: 实景拍摄的 HDRI，以 CC0 发布，提供未裁切的线性高分辨率文件。
entries.notes: The site states the library is CC0 with no AI-generated content, no login and no ads.
entries.notes_zh: 官网声明整站为 CC0，无 AI 生成内容、无需登录、无广告。

entries.name: No Emotion HDRs
entries.description: Free HDR skies for lighting and sky replacement, shot on location rather than generated.
entries.description_zh: 用于打光与天空替换的免费 HDRI 天空，实地拍摄而非生成。
entries.notes: CC BY-ND: commercial use with credit is fine, but the HDRIs must not be modified or redistributed as derivatives.
entries.notes_zh: CC BY-ND：署名后可商用，但不得修改或作为演绎作品再分发这些 HDRI。

entries.name: Share Textures
entries.description: PBR materials and 3D models under a custom CC0-based licence, up to 4K resolution.
entries.description_zh: 采用自定义 CC0 类许可的 PBR 材质与 3D 模型，最高 4K 分辨率。
entries.notes: Custom CC0-based terms: no redistribution or hotlinking, and the licence covers only files downloaded from their own site.
entries.notes_zh: 自定义 CC0 条款：禁止再分发与热链，且许可只覆盖从其官网直接下载的文件。
